meta_description: Kota Bharu Half Marathon 2026: September 5 at Dewan Jubli Perak, Kelantan. State-government-backed 21K, 10K, 5K with registration open.
dek: Set for 5 September 2026 at Dewan Jubli Perak in Kota Bharu, this Yayasan KB Care and Kelantan state government production offers three distances with registration open.
verdict: The Kota Bharu Half Marathon is a state-government-backed Kelantan road race, organised by Yayasan KB Care with the Kelantan state government. Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K) with registration open. Kota Bharu is the capital of Kelantan — Malaysia's northeasternmost state, known for its distinctive Malay culture, traditional crafts, and some of the best food in the country. September is the tail of the southwest monsoon on the east coast. A solid northern Malaysian half marathon with government backing and open registration.
